|strategy=By Joe Alread<ref name="decipher-strategy">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040810172938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/outflank.html Decipher card strategy archive]</ref>

High destiny draws that recycle back into your deck are always a good thing, and [[Outflank]] gives you exactly that, when it comes to Biker Scouts. The first use of this interrupt will be extremely hard to pull off, however to pull the second use off, all you need is to do is get a Biker Scout out on the table and your ready to roll. Your Biker Scout gets power +1, and you get a six destiny back in your deck. Sounds like a good idea to me! All you need to do is remember where that 6 is!

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar and the game-text box) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Endor-D-outflank-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Outflank]]: The game text changes: “both” becomes “at least 2”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
